tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Cards and the header sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the header, inputs and the bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken or secondary areas: scope-tab tracks, muted chips, quiet panels.

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of surface; older components still read it. Use surface in new work.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (11:1 or more in every theme).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, dates, captions, inactive tabs. 3.6:1 on bg and 4.0:1 on surface in Light, 1.9:1 on Golden Hour's bg: keep it to short labels on surface, never long copy or anything that must be read on bg. Flagged.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines, dividers, input borders, chip outlines.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sage. The brand hue: icons, focus rings, ghost-button borders, the spinner, the current stop's live dot. Not for small text.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Sage fill for primary buttons and chip-primary (with white text), and sage text on primary-tint. White on it is 3.7:1 in Light and under 3:1 in Plum Dusk and Night Garden, so button labels rely on their 800 weight; primary-dark on primary-tint is 3.2:1 in Light. Below WCAG AA for small text: flagged, kept exact.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Sage wash: selected chips, success alerts, hover on ghost buttons, the current stop card.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Third voice: "THE" in the wordmark, flight banners, secondary accents.

tokens.name: lavender-dark
tokens.usage: Lavender text, e.g. chip-lavender and flight banners. 4.4:1 on surface and 3.7:1 on lavender-tint in Light: AA only for large or bold text.

tokens.name: lavender-tint
tokens.usage: Lavender wash behind lavender text (flight items, chip-lavender).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold. Accent button fill (with text on it), reminder and outside-dates banners' edge.

tokens.name: accent-dark
tokens.usage: Gold text on accent-tint: reminders, "Outside trip dates" tags. 3.0:1 on accent-tint in every light and medium theme: below AA for small text, flagged.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Gold wash: reminder banners (recovery email, confirm email), outside-dates notices and tags.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Pink: the fourth tag hue (stay banners, avatars).

tokens.name: highlight-dk
tokens.usage: Pink text on highlight-tint (chip-highlight). 3.4:1: AA only for large or bold text.

tokens.name: highlight-tint
tokens.usage: Pink wash behind highlight-dk.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, invalid field borders, field-error text. 4.7:1 on surface in Light; 3.7:1 on danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind danger buttons and the invalid-field focus ring.

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: The Home hero countdown. Caprasimo only.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles on the auth and onboarding screens.

styles.name: field
styles.usage: Every input, select and textarea. Never smaller: iOS zooms the page in on a field under 16px.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons inside cards and banners.

styles.name: hero-kicker
styles.usage: The line above the hero countdown.

styles.name: error
styles.sample: End date can't be before the start date.
styles.usage: Field errors, in danger, under the field.

spacing.note: The code has no spacing variables; these are the steps it actually uses (counted across every stylesheet, Oct 2, 2026). Keep to them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The most used step: gaps between chips and stop cards, small paddings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between form fields in a row and between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop; space above a page title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Banners, small panels, the reminder nudges.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, stop cards, the hero.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large sheets and the hero card on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, scope tabs, badges: always fully round.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Sage-tinted in Light.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised things: stop cards over the hero, dropdowns, sheets.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed header.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Width of the desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable (Apple's guideline): buttons are at least this tall.
